question: Which fixed P7 modules transmit, redundantly reconstruct, complement, or suppress the block-10 residual identity effect when they are allowed to recompute live rather than overwritten by selected-writer clamps?
population: The immutable 64+64 OOD FIT/HOLDOUT rows from the stable P7-plus-identity parent. All 128 subsets are enumerated on both phases; no row, subset, module, interaction, threshold, or sign is selected from these outcomes.

fixed_game.source: The exact selected-writer block-10 residual input installed over each row's registered causal prefix.
fixed_game.source_absent_arm: Self-patch the native block-10 input. Players in S remain live; each player outside S is clamped to its native captured output at registered positions. This must be an exact no-op for every S.
fixed_game.source_present_arm: Install the selected-writer block-10 input. Players in S recompute live under that source; each player outside S is clamped to its native captured output. All non-P7 modules remain live background.
fixed_game.effect_game: E_I(S) is the source-present minus source-absent answer-margin vector for subset S.
fixed_game.decomposition: Exact subset-lattice Mobius dividends are computed on E_I. Module Shapley vectors allocate E_I(P7)-E_I(empty); E_I(empty) is the direct/unmasked-background route. Grabisch-Roubens pair interaction indices are reported separately and may aggregate higher-order dividends.
fixed_game.interpretation: This identifies operational dependence of the identity source on live P7 modules. A large value nominates a route but is not a direct edge until edge-specific interchange/removal holds. Negative interactions indicate redundancy/cancellation; positive interactions indicate complementarity, subject to inspecting the four corresponding outcomes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_all_subset_noop: All immutable authorities and the fixed P7 order match; native/writer capture and every source/subset hook have exact coverage; all 128 source-absent arms replay native and the all-live source-present arm replays the parent's identity_full metrics within 1e-5; finiteness and exact price pass.
predictions.pred_b_exact_mobius_reconstruction_and_s: For every OOD row, Mobius reconstruction of all 128 source-effect values and Shapley efficiency close within 1e-8.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_p7_module_has_stable: The same P7 module has absolute signed Shapley credit >=.03 relative to the full identity-effect norm, with the same sign, on both OOD FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_d_at_least_one_p7_pair_has_stable_i: The same P7 pair has absolute signed Grabisch-Roubens interaction credit >=.03 relative to the full identity-effect norm, with the same sign, on both OOD FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_e_every_source_conditioned_subset_i: Every E_I(S) arm has temporal command-gold collateral <=.01 on both OOD phases.

terminal_rules.direct_background_identity: A/B/E pass and C fails; the tested P7 live modules do not stably mediate the identity source above .03.
terminal_rules.additive_live_module_routes: A/B/C/E pass and D fails; retain stable Shapley routes but no pair interaction claim.
terminal_rules.redundant_or_complementary_live_routes: A--E pass; inspect the signed four-corner outcomes of stable pairs and follow with edge-specific interchange/removal.

tripwires: The source-absent side must execute the same new hook path for all 128 subsets; algebraic no-op assertions without model execution are insufficient.

Enabled players remain live and recompute after all earlier interventions. Disabled players are clamped to native outputs only at registered positions; selected-writer module outputs are never used in this game.
All 128 subsets, Mobius orders, Shapley values, pair indices, signs, bars, and OOD phases are frozen before execution.
Shapley credit or interaction is operational dependence, not a direct edge, semantic unit, weight rank, or compression certificate.
No DAS, learned projector, surrogate tensor network, OOD selection, calibration, or post-outcome subset pruning is allowed.
null: All P7 Shapley credits remain below .03 on at least one OOD phase: identity is carried by the direct residual/unmasked background route at this granularity, and the prior replacement LOO null must not be reinterpreted as hidden P7 mediation.
novelty: Repository search found generic Mobius/Shapley utilities and many complete factorials, but no source-conditioned live-module effect game for the exact block-10 identity source. The immutable predecessor made every full-writer single deletion exactly null, meeting the prospectively registered redundancy trigger; this changes the intervention from selected-writer replacement to live recomputation and is not a repeated LOO or attribution-only sweep.
